text:
julia (design): quick thought: current evals approval is a single modal that covers both casual review and formal sign-off. proposing a lightweight split: 'Quick pass' for rapid review + 'Record sign-off' which captures an immutable audit entry. helps match reviewer -> approver workflows.

anya (product): what's the main tradeoff we're trying to solve? accidental formal sign-offs? auditability?

julia: both. we see two patterns: quick triage where speed matters, and regulatory sign-off where traceability matters. mixing them confuses users.

rahul (eng): backend is fine emitting an extra event for the sign-off path. prefer to version the event: evals.signoff.v1. payload should include user_id, signoff_type: quick|record, prompt_set_sha, tests_approved_count. small change to storage to retain snapshot for "record".

nate (a11y): accessibility notes up front: two actions with similar labels can be ambiguous to screen readers. suggest grouping with aria-labelledby and a concise legend, and ensure each button has aria-describedby pointing to the consequence text. Confirmation dialogs must trap focus and announce with role="alertdialog".

cory (uxresearch): in quick intercepts people liked a verb that matched org language. "Quick pass" felt casual but clear. "Record sign-off" reads as heavy and signals permanence. Avoid verbs like "approve" for quick flows in case of compliance confusion.

julia: mock in figma: side-by-side small/primary layout on the eval row. primary = Quick pass, secondary = Record sign-off. secondary opens a small confirm sheet with audit summary. copy proposals:
```
Primary: Quick pass
Secondary: Record sign-off
Secondary tooltip: Create an audit entry with signer, snapshot, and timestamp
Confirm title: Record sign-off for X tests?
Confirm body: This action will create an immutable audit record. Snapshot will be stored and cannot be deleted.
Buttons: [Cancel] [Record sign-off]
```

anya: suggestion: shorten secondary to "Sign off + record" or "Sign off (record)"? keep it scannable.

julia: ok to try "Sign off + record" to reduce width.

nate: accessibility nit: tooltips alone aren't enough. make the consequence text visible in the UI (small muted copy) and reference that from screen reader-only text. tooltips must be keyboard focusable.

rahul: keyboard plan: set shortcuts: Ctrl/Cmd+Enter = Quick pass, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Enter = Sign off + record. frontend will emit telemetry with a field `trigger: ui|shortcut|api`. I'll add to the contract.

cory: please surface the shortcuts in a tiny hint under the primary button during first run (dismissible). in usability tests users discovered them more often when hinted. include 2 SR participants.

julia: bulk approve behavior: when user selects multiple test cases, the sheet should show counts and a summarized diff (domains affected) not the full list. confirm copy must call out "X items will be signed off" so users don't get overwhelmed.

nate: extra a11y: when sign-off completes, announce with aria-live polite: "Signed off: X tests. Audit ID 0xABC123" and move focus to the result panel. toast with link to audit should be keyboard dismissable and reachable.

rahul: storage note: we won't snapshot full transcripts for >1000 items by default, instead store a compressed manifest and a link to archived bundle (S3). include `archive_url` in event payload for record sign-offs. sample payload: `{"user_id":"u123","type":"record","prompt_set_sha":"abc","count":42,"audit_id":"0xABC123","archive_url":"https://..."}`

anya: rollout: behind org-level feature flag. default behavior unchanged. enable for beta enterprise orgs first. metrics to watch: time-to-approve, percent of quick vs record, accidental sign-offs (flagged by undo within 2 minutes).

julia: QA checklist for PR: focus order, SR labels, keyboard shortcuts work, tooltip accessible alt, modal aria-role/labels, toast contains audit link and is focusable, bulk confirm summary renders correctly.

ci-bot: Created ticket #4762: "evals: split quick pass + sign-off + audit" and assigned to rahul.

anya: decision: move forward with split affordance labeled "Quick pass" / "Sign off + record", with shortcuts and a11y callouts. behind flag, beta rollout.

julia: action items: @rahul open the event schema PR (assign to infra), @nate add a11y checklist to PR template, @cory schedule 6 moderated sessions (include 2 SR), I'll update figma and post link. target: start beta next week.

rahul: ack, will open branch tomorrow and add schema draft.

nate: will draft checklist and post to repo.

cory: invites sent.

julia: thanks all, will post updated mocks when branch lands. :sparkles:
